headline: Foxconn Industrial Internet completes share buyback, spending RMB 1 billion | Securities
summary: Foxconn Industrial Internet has completed its share buyback after reaching the lower limit of the plan, with total funds used of RMB 1 billion. The buyback was announced by parent Foxconn.
why: Foxconn Industrial Internet is a subsidiary of Foxconn, the largest contract electronics manufacturer, and buybacks reduce the number of shares outstanding.
